https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: The site provides automated and on-demand environments for software development teams to test and deploy applications efficiently.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create on-demand environments for software testing and development.
Users must be able to integrate the platform with their existing CI/CD pipelines for seamless deployment workflows.
Administrators must be able to manage user access and permissions for team collaboration on environments.
Users must be able to monitor and analyze environment performance and logs for debugging purposes.
Users must be able to schedule the automatic termination of environments to optimize resource usage.
The platform must allow users to clone pre-configured environments to replicate testing scenarios quickly.
Users must be able to access documentation and support resources directly from the interface for troubleshooting and implementation guidance.
